content.title: Reading Practice: Short Workplace Sentences
content.scenario_summary: Thirty independent business situations cover trade-fair booth responsibility, affordable market fees, product withdrawal, complimentary photography prints, software recovery, translation estimates, harbor-tour equipment, association fees, audio demonstrations, wholesale bakery benefits, studio scheduling, bicycle repairs, rental equipment, restored shuttle bookings, donor recognition, tablet returns, moving-day elevators, survey analysis, newspaper staffing, awards attendance, furniture delivery, conference assumptions, staff training, recruitment instructions, coworking capacity, paper recycling, hotel service rankings, employee suggestions, catering requests, and museum maintenance follow-up.

questions.prompt: Responsibility {{q1}} assigning booth locations at the trade fair rests with the event coordinator.

explanation.summary_zh: A 的 for 可接在 responsibility 後，指出負責的事項。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句子將「分配攤位位置的責任」交由活動協調員承擔。responsibility for 後接 assigning booth locations，說明責任的內容；後面的 rests with 則指出責任歸屬的人。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: for 接在 responsibility 後，可用 for doing something 表示有責任做某事，符合分配攤位的語意。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: with 可出現在 responsibility rests with someone，指出由誰承擔責任，但不適合此處 responsibility with assigning 的組合。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: to 可用於 responsibility to someone，或接不定詞說明義務；此處後接 assigning，應使用 for。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: on 不用來在本句引出 responsibility 的具體內容；responsibility on assigning 無法表達所需關係。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 區分 responsibility for 後的工作內容與 rests with 後的負責者。

questions.prompt: The farmers market keeps stall fees {{q2}} enough for growers with small budgets to sell there regularly.

explanation.summary_zh: B 的 modest 表示金額不高，符合小額預算的攤商也能負擔。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 後半句說預算有限的種植者也能經常來販售，因此攤位費必須維持在不高的水準。modest 可形容金額不大；其他三個形容詞都表示費用高或過高。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: steep 形容費用時表示昂貴，與讓預算有限者能經常擺攤的目的相反。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: modest 可形容費用不高，與 small budgets 及 regularly 共同呈現的負擔能力相符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: substantial 形容金額相當可觀，無法表達此處刻意壓低攤位費以利小額預算攤商的意思。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: excessive 表示超出合理程度，與讓小額預算的種植者能負擔的語境衝突。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 形容價格的字要連同付款者的預算與句中的目的判斷。

questions.prompt: Retiring its solvent-based ink colors one at a time, the art-supply company plans to {{q3}} the entire range within a year.

explanation.summary_zh: C 的 phase out 表示逐步淘汰，呼應一款一款停止供應的安排。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句首的 Retiring ... one at a time 已說明該公司正在逐款停供溶劑型墨水。計畫在一年內結束整個系列，對應 phase out 的逐步淘汰之意。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: build up 表示逐步擴充或增加；此系列正在逐款停供，並非要擴大品項。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: bring back 表示重新推出；這與目前逐款停止供應整個系列的方向相反。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: phase out 表示分階段停止使用或供應，與 one at a time 及 entire range 的安排吻合。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: take over 表示接管；本句談的是公司逐款淘汰自家墨水系列，沒有接手他人業務的情境。

explanation.takeaway_zh: phase out 強調分階段退出；先看產品變動的方向與進程。

questions.prompt: The product photographer marked the extra prints as {{q4}} on the invoice, indicating that the client would not be charged for them.

explanation.summary_zh: D 的 complimentary 表示免費提供，符合帳單註明客戶不會被收取加印照片費用的狀態。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 後面的 indicating 子句直接說明帳單標示的含意：這些加印照片不向客戶收費。complimentary 可表示免費附贈；refundable、reimbursable 與 deductible 則分別涉及退款、報銷及費用扣除，並不表示免收費。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: refundable 表示款項可退還，並非一開始就不收費；它不能表達此處帳單標示的免收費含意。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: reimbursable 表示費用可獲補償或報銷，不等於攝影師不向客戶收費，與標示所說明的狀態不同。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: deductible 表示費用可列作扣除項目，並不是商家免收費；此處要表達的是加印照片不計費。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: complimentary 可形容免費提供的物品，準確對應客戶不會被收取這些加印照片費用的說明。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 區分 complimentary 的免收費狀態與退款、報銷或費用扣除等不同處理方式。

questions.prompt: {{q5}}, the software subscription includes automatic backups, so yesterday's deleted files can be recovered.

explanation.summary_zh: B 的 Fortunately 是副詞，可在句首評述能還原檔案是件幸運的事。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格後有逗號，後方已是一個完整句子，因此此處需要能評述整件事的副詞。Fortunately 表示「幸好」，呼應自動備份讓誤刪檔案仍可還原的正面結果。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: Fortunate 是形容詞，可形容人或情況幸運，但不能在本句以單獨形容詞加逗號完成所需的句子評述。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Fortunately 是副詞，放在句首並以逗號隔開，可評述後方整件事情令人慶幸。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Fortune 是名詞，意為運氣或財富；本句沒有讓它擔任主詞等名詞成分的位置。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Fortunes 是複數名詞，不能在此處取代評述完整句子的副詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 句首加逗號的評述語可用副詞，判斷其是否修飾整件事。

questions.prompt: The translation agency's estimate remained {{q6}} for thirty days, giving the client time to review the proposed schedule.

explanation.summary_zh: A 的 valid 是形容詞，可在 remained 後說明報價仍然有效。
explanation.reasoning_zh: remained 在此是連綴動詞，後面要補充主詞 estimate 的狀態。valid 表示有效，與 thirty days 的有效期間相符；不是要修飾 remain 這個動作的方式。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: valid 是形容詞，作主詞補語，說明估價單在三十天內仍有效。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: validity 是名詞「有效性」，不能在此處直接構成 remained validity 來描述報價狀態。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: validate 是動詞「使生效、驗證」，不適合直接接在本句的連綴動詞 remained 後。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: validly 是副詞，可修飾某個行為是否有效成立，但此處需要描述 estimate 狀態的形容詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 連綴動詞後若要說明主詞的狀態，應辨認所需的形容詞補語。

questions.prompt: A life jacket must {{q7}} to every child before the harbor tour boat leaves the dock.

explanation.summary_zh: C 的 be provided 使救生衣成為被提供的物品，構成正確被動語態。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 主詞 a life jacket 是要提供給孩童的物品，to every child 則指出接受者。本句的 provide 需要用被動形式，因此 must 後接 be provided；句中不必寫出提供者。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: provide 是主動原形，會把救生衣放在提供東西的角色，而且 to every child 前也缺少所提供的受詞。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: have provided 是主動完成式，仍未把救生衣表達為被提供的物品，無法完成本句所需結構。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: be provided 與 must 構成情態助動詞的被動形式，表示救生衣必須被提供給每位孩童。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: be providing 是主動進行形式；此處救生衣是提供的物品，並非執行提供動作的主詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 依主詞在實際動作中的角色判斷主被動；情態助動詞的被動可用 be 加過去分詞。

questions.prompt: Membership fees rise {{q8}} with firm size under the professional association's new pricing structure.

explanation.summary_zh: D 的 proportionately 是副詞，可修飾費用隨公司規模上升的方式。
explanation.reasoning_zh: rise 是本句的動詞，空格說明會費如何隨公司規模增加，因此需要副詞 proportionately，意為按比例地。with firm size 表示費用變化所對應的公司規模。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: proportional 是形容詞，例如 fees are proportional to firm size；本句用 rise 作動詞，這裡需要副詞。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: proportion 是名詞「比例」，無法直接以 rise proportion with firm size 修飾上升方式。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: proportionate 可作形容詞，形容相稱的狀態；在此處不能取代修飾 rise 的副詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: proportionately 是副詞，說明會費按公司規模的變化而相應上升。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 分清 be proportional to 的形容詞補語與 rise proportionately 的動詞修飾語。

questions.prompt: The audio-equipment distributor {{q9}} retailers with demonstration units so their customers can compare speakers before buying.

explanation.summary_zh: A 的 supplies 可用 supply someone with something 表示提供物品。
explanation.reasoning_zh: retailers 是接受展示機的對象，with demonstration units 指提供的物品。supply someone with something 完整符合此搭配；其他選項要表達同樣意思時，受詞與介系詞的安排不同。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: supplies 可用 supplies retailers with demonstration units，表示供應展示機給零售商。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: offers 可用 offers retailers demonstration units，或 offers units to retailers，但不以本句的 offers retailers with units 表達提供。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: delivers 通常把物品放在動詞後，再用 to 指接受者；delivers retailers with units 不能表達此處配送展示機的意思。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: grants 可接人再接授予的物品或權利；本句的 grants retailers with units 不是所需搭配。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 記動詞時連同受詞順序與介系詞：supply 人 with 物。

questions.prompt: The bakery offers wholesale customers free delivery; {{q10}}, it supplies display labels at no extra charge.

explanation.summary_zh: C 的 furthermore 用來補充批發客戶可享有的另一項免費服務。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句提到免費配送，後句再加上免費提供展示標籤。兩者都是批發服務的優點，後句是在補充前句，因此使用表示「此外」的 furthermore。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: instead 表示改用另一件事取代原來的事；句中兩項免費服務並存，沒有替代關係。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: otherwise 常表示「否則」或「在其他方面」；這裡不是前項條件未成立時的結果，也不是轉述其他方面的差異。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: furthermore 表示進一步補充，適合連接免費配送與免費標籤這兩項服務。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: nevertheless 表示儘管如此仍出現另一結果；後句與前句同為客戶利益，沒有要克服的反差。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先辨認前後命題是補充、替代、條件結果或讓步，再選連接副詞。

questions.prompt: The architectural studio postponed its presentation {{q11}} the client requested more time to review the drawings.

explanation.summary_zh: B 的 because 後可接完整子句，說明簡報延期的原因。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格後有主詞 the client、動詞 requested 及受詞 more time，是完整原因子句。because 能引導此子句；because of、owing to、due to 在本句的因果用法下要接名詞片語等成分。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: because of 可以接 the client’s request 等名詞片語，但不能直接接本句的 the client requested 完整子句。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: because 可引導 the client requested more time 這個完整子句，說明延期原因。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: owing to 可接名詞片語表示由於，但不適合直接接此處具有主詞與限定動詞的子句。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: due to 可接名詞片語說明原因；若要引出本句子句，可改成 due to the fact that，而非直接使用 due to。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 因果連接詞與介系詞片語的選擇，要看後方是完整子句還是名詞片語。

questions.prompt: The bicycle shop's owner and her assistant {{q12}} trained to repair both standard and electric bicycles.

explanation.summary_zh: D 的 are 配合由店主與助理兩人組成的並列主詞。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 主詞是 the bicycle shop’s owner and her assistant，指兩位不同的人，因此本句用 are trained 說明兩人都受過訓練。不能只看最接近空格的 assistant 就使用單數動詞。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: is 配合第三人稱單數主詞；本句主詞由店主與助理兩人並列組成，不適用。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: train 可不及物地表示接受或進行訓練；但 has 與店主及助理這個兩人並列主詞不一致，若用完成式應搭配 have。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: was 是與第三人稱單數主詞搭配的過去式，本句兩人並列的主詞不與 was 一致。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: are 與本句並列的兩人主詞一致，are trained 表示店主及助理均受過訓練。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 主詞動詞一致要找完整主詞，別被靠近動詞的單一名詞誤導。

questions.prompt: The rental coordinator can arrange delivery of {{q13}} equipment your project requires, including ladders, generators, and lighting.

explanation.summary_zh: A 的 whatever 可接 equipment，表示專案需要的任何設備。
explanation.reasoning_zh: whatever equipment your project requires 整體是名詞性成分，放在 of 後，表示「專案所需的任何設備」。equipment 是 requires 的受詞，whatever 在名詞前表達不限種類的選擇。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: whatever 可接名詞 equipment，組成「專案需要的任何設備」這個名詞性結構。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: whoever 指任何人，不能在此處修飾 equipment 這個設備名詞。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: however 可表示方式或接形容詞表程度，但 however equipment your project requires 無法形成此處所需的名詞性成分。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: whenever 指任何時間，不能接 equipment 表示不限種類的設備。

explanation.takeaway_zh: whatever 加名詞可表示不限選擇的事物，並讓整個結構擔任名詞成分。

questions.prompt: The airport shuttle company {{q14}} its online booking service, which passengers are already using to reserve seats again.

explanation.summary_zh: C 的 has restored 表示服務已恢復，並帶來乘客現在可重新訂位的結果。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 後方的關係子句說乘客已經在使用這項線上服務重新訂位，顯示服務恢復已完成且有當前結果。四個選項中，現在完成式 has restored 與這個時間框架相符。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: will restore 把服務恢復放在未來，與乘客目前已重新使用該線上服務訂位的資訊不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: has yet to restore 表示仍未恢復；乘客卻已重新使用這項線上服務訂位，與尚未恢復的狀態不符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: has restored 表示恢復已完成且與現在有關，後方乘客已在使用該服務的情況正是其當前結果。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: will be restoring 表示未來一段時間將進行恢復工作，無法配合乘客現在已重新使用該服務的情況。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 現在完成式可連接已完成的改變與當前結果；要從句中時間框架選擇。

questions.prompt: The public library's director {{q15}} the donor's generosity during her speech by thanking him for the new computers.

explanation.summary_zh: D 的 acknowledged 表示公開表達認可與謝意，符合致詞時感謝捐贈者的行為。
explanation.reasoning_zh: by thanking him 明確說明館長做出的行為是感謝捐贈者。acknowledge someone’s generosity 可表示對某人的慷慨作出表揚或致謝，符合這場公開致詞的內容。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: solicited 表示請求或募集；此處是在感謝已捐贈的新電腦，不是在向對方請求捐贈。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: disputed 表示反駁或對某事提出爭議，與明確感謝捐贈者慷慨行為的描述不符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: questioned 表示質疑；本句說明的是以感謝表達肯定，沒有質疑捐贈者慷慨與否。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: acknowledged 可表示公開承認並表達感謝，與致詞中感謝新電腦捐贈的行為相符。

explanation.takeaway_zh: acknowledge 除了承認事實，也可表示對貢獻公開致謝或給予認可。

questions.prompt: Customers should remove {{q16}} personal files from returned tablets before handing the devices to a sales assistant.

explanation.summary_zh: B 的 their 可直接修飾 personal files，表示顧客自己的私人檔案。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格後已有名詞片語 personal files，因此需要放在名詞前的所有格限定詞 their，指向主詞 Customers。theirs 是可獨立代替名詞片語的所有格代名詞，不能直接修飾這裡的 files。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: theirs 是獨立使用的所有格代名詞，不在本句中直接接 personal files 這個名詞片語。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: their 是所有格限定詞，可修飾 personal files，並指向正在退回平板的顧客。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: them 是受格代名詞，不能放在此處作 personal files 的所有格限定詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: they 是主格代名詞；本句已有 Customers 作主詞，空格需要的是修飾檔案的所有格形式。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 名詞已寫出時可用 their 修飾；theirs 則獨立代替所屬的名詞片語。

questions.prompt: Of the two elevators available during the office move, one is reserved for furniture only and {{q17}} is for staff only.

explanation.summary_zh: C 的 the other 指兩部電梯中，專供員工使用的另一部。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句首明確把範圍限定為 two elevators，並說一部只供運家具，另一部只供員工。兩種用途以 only 明確分開，因此用 the other 指剩下的一部，而不是用 each 把員工用途套到兩部。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: each 指兩部中的每一部，會把運家具的那部也說成僅供員工使用，與 furniture only 的明確限定衝突。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: other 在此不能單獨作為指稱一部電梯的單數名詞成分，需要 the other 等完整形式。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: the other 特指兩者中剩下的另一個，符合 one ... the other 的分配。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: others 指其他多個人事物；已知兩部中剩下一部，而且後面是 is，不符合本句。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先確認集合是否已限定；兩者中扣除一個後的另一個可用 the other。

questions.prompt: The customer research team conducted an {{q18}} of survey responses to identify recurring complaints about the checkout process.

explanation.summary_zh: A 的 analysis 指分析過程，能幫助團隊找出反覆出現的客訴。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 團隊要從問卷回答辨識重複出現的問題，因此進行了資料分析。conducted an analysis of survey responses 表示實際執行這項研究工作；outcome 與 implication 指結果或意涵，estimate 則指估算。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: analysis 表示仔細分析資料，可作 conducted 的受詞，符合從問卷回答中辨識重複客訴的工作。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: outcome 表示結果，不是可用 conducted an outcome 表達的研究分析活動。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: implication 表示含意或可能影響，不是本句以 conducted 表示實際進行的研究活動。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: estimate 表示對數量、金額等作概略估算；此處要分析回答內容找出重複客訴，並未在估算數量。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 區分研究的分析過程 analysis、結果 outcome 與可能意涵 implication。

questions.prompt: {{q19}} small its reporting team is, the local newspaper still publishes a full daily edition.

explanation.summary_zh: D 的 However 與 small 組成程度讓步結構，表示不論採訪小組多小，仍刊行完整日報。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格後先出現形容詞 small，再接主詞 its reporting team 與動詞 is。However small ... 表示「不論……多小」，整個子句與主句的 still 共同表達讓步；這個語序需要程度用法的 however。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: Wherever 表示不論何處，不能在本句的 small 加主詞、動詞語序中引出規模多小的程度讓步。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Whenever 表示不論何時，不用來修飾此處前置的形容詞 small；Whenever small its reporting team is 無法形成所需結構。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Whatever 可接名詞表示任何事物，但此處是形容詞 small 後接完整主詞 its reporting team，不能組成 whatever 加名詞的結構。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: However 可接形容詞 small，再接主詞及動詞，構成「不論採訪小組多小」的程度讓步子句。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 辨認 however 加形容詞、主詞及動詞的程度讓步結構，可表「不論多……仍……」。

questions.prompt: {{q20}} both finalists can attend the business awards ceremony has yet to be confirmed by their assistants.

explanation.summary_zh: B 的 Whether 可引導名詞子句作主詞，表示兩位決選者能否出席。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 整個「兩位決選者是否能出席」是 has yet to be confirmed 的主詞，描述尚待確認的問題。句首的主詞子句使用 Whether；If 雖可在部分受詞子句中表示是否，但不適用此處的句首主詞結構。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: Unless 引導例外條件子句，不能在本句中把「是否能出席」組成名詞性主詞。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Whether 引導 whether both finalists can attend ... 這個名詞子句，作整句的單一主詞。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: If 在表示是否時可出現在某些動詞後，但本句要直接用子句作句首主詞，應使用 Whether。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Although 引導讓步子句，無法在此處擔任尚待確認的議題這個名詞性主詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 以「是否」子句直接作句首主詞時，使用 whether 引出待確認的議題。

questions.prompt: The {{q21}} of next week's furniture delivery gives the warehouse time to combine two orders into one shipment.

explanation.summary_zh: A 的 postponement 是名詞，作主詞中心語，表示家具配送延期這件事。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 本句的限定動詞是 gives，前面的主詞需以名詞為中心。postponement 後接 of next week’s furniture delivery，說明延後的是哪件事；整個主詞表示延期讓倉庫有時間合併出貨。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: postponement 是名詞「延期」，可作主詞中心語，後面的 of 片語補充延期的對象。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: postpone 是動詞原形，不能在 The postpone of ... 中直接作本句所需的主詞名詞。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: postponed 是動詞過去式或過去分詞；The postponed of ... 缺少它可修飾的名詞，也不構成此處主詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: postpones 是第三人稱單數動詞形式，不能取代 The 與 of 片語之間需要的名詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先找主句動詞，再辨認長主詞中由名詞擔任的中心語。

questions.prompt: The conference planner acted on the understanding {{q22}} the hotel would provide projectors in all six meeting rooms.

explanation.summary_zh: D 的 that 引出完整子句，說明會議規劃者所依據的共識內容。
explanation.reasoning_zh: the hotel would provide projectors in all six meeting rooms 已有完整主詞、動詞和受詞。that 引導補充 understanding 內容的子句，不在子句中另擔任主詞或受詞。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: which 若引導修飾 understanding 的關係子句，需在其中擔任適當成分；後方子句已完整，沒有這個位置。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: what 常把「所……的事物」組成名詞性結構，並在其中擔任成分；此處需要的是連接完整內容子句的 that。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: whose 表示所屬關係，後面需接被其限定的名詞；本句不是要說明誰的飯店。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: that 可引出完整子句，說明 understanding 的具體內容是飯店會在六間會議室提供投影機。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 抽象名詞後的 that 子句可說明內容；檢查子句本身是否已完整。

questions.prompt: Staff members {{q23}} complete the introductory course can register for advanced training sessions next month.

explanation.summary_zh: B 的 who 指員工，並在關係子句中作 complete 的主詞。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 主句是 Staff members can register ...，中間的關係子句限定哪些員工可以報名。complete 前沒有其他主詞，因此需要用 who 指向 staff members，並擔任該子句的主詞。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: whom 是受格形式；這個關係子句缺的是 complete 的主詞，不是受詞。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: who 指前面的 staff members，並作 complete 的主詞，完整表達完成入門課程的員工。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: whose 表示所屬，需接被其限定的名詞；此處後面直接是動詞 complete，不是所屬名詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: which 在本句不適合用來指稱這些員工；此處要以 who 引出以人為先行詞的主詞關係子句。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷關係代名詞時，同時看先行詞與它在關係子句中的職務。

questions.prompt: The recruiter outlined the application steps {{q24}}, specifying exactly which documents to submit and where to send them.

explanation.summary_zh: C 的 explicitly 表示明白具體地，呼應清楚指明文件及寄送地點。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 後方的 specifying exactly 說明招募人員把應交文件與寄送地點直接講清楚，因此方式是 explicitly。四個選項都描述表達方式，需依明確說出細節的資訊選擇。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: vaguely 表示含糊、不具體，與逐項明確指出要交哪些文件及寄到何處不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: implicitly 表示以暗示、未直接說明的方式；後方 specifying exactly 描述的是直接說清楚。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: explicitly 表示明白具體地，符合精確說明文件種類與寄送地點的內容。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: ambiguously 表示可能有不同解讀、不明確；本句強調 exactly，並非留下解讀歧義。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 比較方式副詞時，找出後文對實際說法或做法的具體描述。

questions.prompt: With room for only one more desk, the coworking office has {{q25}} space left for additional members.

explanation.summary_zh: C 的 little 可修飾不可數的 space，並表達剩餘空間很少。
explanation.reasoning_zh: space 在此指辦公室空間，作不可數名詞使用。句首說只容得下一張額外桌子，數量應是很少，因此選 little；much 雖可修飾此處的 space，卻與所述空間有限的程度不符。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: few 用來修飾可數複數名詞；本句的 space 指整體空間，不是複數的個別位置。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: many 也修飾可數複數名詞，與此處不可數的 space 不搭配。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: little 修飾不可數名詞並表示量少，符合只剩放一張桌子的空間。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: much 可修飾不可數名詞，但表示量大；本句明確強調只容得下一張額外桌子，應表達量少。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 數量詞要同時符合名詞的可數性與句中實際呈現的多寡。

questions.prompt: Recycling bins {{q26}} with locking lids are reserved for offices handling confidential documents.

explanation.summary_zh: A 的 equipped 作後置分詞修飾語，指出配有可上鎖桶蓋的回收桶。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 主句動詞是 are reserved，equipped with locking lids 修飾前面的 bins，說明哪些桶被保留使用。equip 的主動搭配是 equip something with something；此處 bins 是被配備的對象，因此用帶被動意義的過去分詞。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: equipped 是過去分詞，與 with locking lids 一起修飾 bins，表示這些桶配有可上鎖的桶蓋。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: equipping 若作主動分詞，equip 後仍需要被配備的對象；此處 with locking lids 只引出配件，沒有完成該主動搭配。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: equips 是第三人稱單數限定動詞，不與複數 bins 一致，也無法直接接在此處與 are reserved 形成完整結構。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: equip 是原形；即使按複數主詞看成現在式動詞，也會與 are reserved 形成未連接的限定動詞，不能作所需的後置分詞修飾語。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先找主句動詞，再依 equip 物品 with 配件的關係辨認被動分詞修飾語。

questions.prompt: Hotel guests ranked the late checkout option second {{q27}} useful among the six complimentary services listed in the survey.

explanation.summary_zh: D 的 most 組成 second most useful，表示六項服務中實用程度排名第二。
explanation.reasoning_zh: among the six complimentary services 明確指出排名範圍，second most useful 表示實用程度位居第二。這裡是序數加最高級的排名結構，不是以冠詞有無來決定答案。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: more useful 是比較級；本句要表達在六項服務中的第二名，應使用 second most useful 這個排名結構。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: much 可加強某些比較級，但 much useful 不能在本句構成實用程度的第二名。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: very useful 表示很實用，卻不能與 second 組成本句需要的六者排名形式。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: most 與 second、useful 組成 second most useful，準確表達六項服務中排名第二。

explanation.takeaway_zh: second most 加形容詞可表達集合中的第二名；依比較範圍與排名語意判斷。

questions.prompt: The benefits committee welcomes {{q28}} from employees about possible improvements to the company's wellness program.

explanation.summary_zh: B 的 suggestions 是名詞，可作 welcomes 的受詞，表示員工提出的建議。
explanation.reasoning_zh: welcomes 在此是及物動詞，後面要接被歡迎的事物。suggestions 作直接受詞，from employees 表示建議來源，about possible improvements 則說明建議內容。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: suggest 是動詞原形，不能在此處直接作 welcomes 的名詞受詞。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: suggestions 是複數名詞，可直接作 welcomes 的受詞，表示來自員工的改善建議。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: suggestive 是形容詞，不能單獨在此處表示員工提出的建議並充當所需受詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: suggestively 是副詞，不是本句要表達的建議事物，也不能取代 welcomes 後的受詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先找及物動詞所需的受詞，再選能表達該事物的名詞形式。

questions.prompt: The restaurant expanded its vegetarian catering menu in {{q29}} to requests from several corporate clients.

explanation.summary_zh: D 的 response 與 in、to 組成 in response to，表示回應客戶的要求。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 餐廳因多家企業客戶的要求而擴充素食外燴菜單。in response to requests 表示「為回應要求」；其他名詞雖也可用在商務片語中，卻不與本句既有的 in ... to 組合。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: accordance 用在 in accordance with，表示依照；本句後面是 to，不能構成所需片語。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: compliance 常用 in compliance with 表示遵從，不能在本句組成 in compliance to requests。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: preparation 可用 in preparation for 表示為某事準備；此處 to requests 並非該片語所需的搭配。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: response 可組成 in response to requests，表示餐廳擴充菜單是在回應企業客戶的要求。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 名詞搭配要連同兩側介系詞記憶，例如 in response to 與 in accordance with。

questions.prompt: Following reports of faulty display lights, the museum will check its maintenance records to {{q30}} what caused the problem.

explanation.summary_zh: A 的 find out 表示查明，符合檢查維修紀錄以釐清故障原因的目的。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 博物館接獲展示燈故障的通報後，要查看維修紀錄，目的是查明原因。find out 可接 what caused the problem 這類疑問內容子句，表達透過調查得知答案。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: find out 表示查明或得知，後接 what caused the problem，符合查閱紀錄的調查目的。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: put off 表示延後；此處要查明已發生問題的原因，不是延後造成問題的事物或行動。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: carry on 表示繼續進行，不能在此處以 carry on what caused the problem 表達查明故障原因。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: go ahead 表示繼續進行，可用 go ahead with something 等結構；本句直接接 what caused the problem，既未形成所需搭配，也沒有表達查明原因。

explanation.takeaway_zh: find out 可接疑問內容子句，表示經由查詢或調查而得知答案。

content.title: Maintenance Briefing Location Notice
content.scenario_summary: Ceiling repairs require a heating-control briefing to move upstairs temporarily. A prior trial split attendees between the quiet upstairs room and easier downstairs access. Existing registrations transfer, and cancellations release places to a waiting list.

blocks.text: Revised Location for Maintenance Briefing
Ceiling repairs will close the ground-floor meeting room from November 9 through 13. The heating-control briefing will move to the third-floor training room on November 11 at 5:30 P.M.
At last month's trial briefing upstairs, six attendees preferred the quiet setting, while six wanted to return downstairs for easier access. Feedback on moving upstairs permanently was {{q1}}.
Although no permanent move has been agreed on, we are {{q2}} that the room will work well for this session. It has a working demonstration panel. {{q3}}, there is seating for everyone registered.
Existing registrations will transfer automatically; only cancellations need a reply. {{q4}} We will offer any places released by these replies to tenants on the waiting list before the briefing.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 六人偏好樓上，另六人希望回樓下，因此意見是 divided（分歧的）。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格所在句只說要評述永久搬到樓上的回饋，必須參照前一句的實際意見。六人喜歡安靜的樓上，另六人為了方便進出而希望回樓下，形成兩種相反偏好，因此 divided 最能概括這些回饋。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: enthusiastic 表示熱烈支持；六人希望回樓下，不能把對永久搬遷的整體回饋概括為熱烈支持。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: unanimous 表示意見一致；前句明確呈現六人偏好樓上、六人偏好樓下，並非一致。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: indifferent 表示不在意；兩組與會者各自表達了地點偏好與理由，不是對地點毫不在意。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: divided 表示意見分歧，準確對應兩組人分別偏好樓上與樓下的情況。

evidence.quote: At last month's trial briefing upstairs, six attendees preferred the quiet setting, while six wanted to return downstairs for easier access.
Feedback on moving upstairs permanently was {{q1}}.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷評價詞時，先辨認前文各方的實際立場，再選能概括整體意見的詞。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

explanation.summary_zh: confident 作為 are 的補語，表示我們有信心這個房間能滿足本次需求。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 此處的 we are confident that ... 用形容詞 confident 描述主詞 we 的心理狀態，後面的 that 子句說明有信心的內容，也就是房間適合本次活動。選項中的名詞、副詞與原形動詞均不能在這個結構中表達該意思。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: confident 是形容詞，可在 we are 後作補語，並接 that 子句說明有信心的內容。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: confidence 是「信心」這個抽象名詞；we are confidence that ... 不能表達此處「我們有信心」的意思。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: confidently 是副詞，表示有信心地做某事；此處需要直接描述 we 狀態的補語，並沒有供它修飾的動作。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: confide 是「吐露、傾訴」的原形動詞，不能直接接在 are 後構成此處所需的表達。

evidence.quote: Although no permanent move has been agreed on, we are {{q2}} that the room will work well for this session.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷詞性時，要確認空格在整句中的補語功能，以及後接子句的結構。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 示範面板與足夠座位是兩項支持理由，用 Furthermore 補充說明。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前文表示這個房間適合本次活動，接著提出可用的示範面板。空格後的座位充足則是另一項優點，與前項並列支持同一判斷，因此使用 Furthermore（此外）。兩項優點之間沒有替代、因果或讓步關係。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: Instead 表示改以另一件事取代前項；座位充足並沒有取代示範面板，兩者都存在。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Consequently 表示因此；文中沒有說示範面板造成座位充足，兩者是分別列出的優點。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Furthermore 表示此外，將座位充足加在示範面板之後，提供支持房間適用的另一項理由。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Nevertheless 表示儘管如此；有示範面板與有足夠座位並不形成此處需要的逆向或讓步關係。

evidence.quote: It has a working demonstration panel. {{q3}}, there is seating for everyone registered.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 連接詞要依前後命題的關係選擇；並列增加一項支持理由可用 furthermore。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

options.label: A
options.text: Please reply with your name to secure your place in the upstairs room.

options.label: B
options.text: Please notify Facilities if the new location means you cannot attend.

options.label: C
options.text: Please confirm your attendance even if you can use the upstairs room.

options.label: D
options.text: Please wait until after the briefing to tell us that you cannot attend.

explanation.summary_zh: 應請因地點更改而無法出席的人通知取消，才能在活動前把名額讓給候補者。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句說原有報名會自動轉移，只有取消者需要回覆。後句的 these replies 必須指能釋出名額的取消通知，而且工作人員要在簡報前安排候補者。因此，空格應請因新地點而無法參加的人通知 Facilities。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此句要求回覆姓名來保留名額，但原有報名已自動轉移，而且前句明說只有取消者需要回覆。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 請無法到新地點的人通知，符合只有取消者須回覆的規則，也讓後文能把釋出的名額交給候補者。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此句要求仍可出席者也確認，與 only cancellations need a reply 明確衝突；這類確認也不會釋出名額。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 雖然談的是無法出席的通知，但要求活動後才回報，無法支持後文在活動前把釋出名額提供給候補者的安排。

evidence.quote: Existing registrations will transfer automatically; only cancellations need a reply.
We will offer any places released by these replies to tenants on the waiting list before the briefing.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 補入下一步指示時，同時檢查前文的回覆條件與後文代詞所指，以及行動時間。

content.title: A First Shift at Shoreline Pantry
content.scenario_summary: A first-time pantry volunteer praises effective personal instruction, reports an error in printed packing steps, answers the coordinator's follow-up inquiry, and sees the suggested changes adopted promptly.

documents.title: A First Shift at Shoreline Pantry

blocks.text: A First Shift at Shoreline Pantry
Review by Mara Lin
Shoreline Pantry assigned four newcomers to a training table on Saturday. An instructor showed {{q1}} how to check package dates, and all four packed a bag correctly on the first attempt.
{{q2}} The task cards, which we used after the instructor left, caused confusion because two packing steps appeared in the wrong order. I mentioned this in my end-of-shift comments.

The coordinator thanked me the next morning and offered to send me a replacement card. Before preparing it, she asked which two step numbers needed exchanging. I sent the numbers in response to her {{q3}}.
Within an hour of my reply, she sent a corrected card incorporating every change I had suggested. My suggestions had clearly been {{q4}}. I would recommend this program to anyone new to volunteering.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

explanation.summary_zh: them 指前句介紹的四位新志工。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格是 showed 的受詞，指接受示範的四位新志工。前句的 four newcomers 與同句稍後的 all four 都指這個複數人物群體，因此使用受格代名詞 them。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: him 指單一男性，無法回指這裡的四位新志工。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: them 是複數受格代名詞，可回指 four newcomers，作 showed 的受詞。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: her 指單一女性，與此處四位新志工的複數指涉不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: it 指單一事物等，不能在這裡回指四位新志工。

evidence.quote: Shoreline Pantry assigned four newcomers to a training table on Saturday. An instructor showed {{q1}} how to check package dates, and all four packed a bag correctly on the first attempt.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 選代名詞時，先確認指涉對象的人數與句中角色。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

options.label: A
options.text: The face-to-face training was more useful than the printed instructions.

options.label: B
options.text: The face-to-face training was less useful than the printed instructions.

options.label: C
options.text: Neither the face-to-face training nor the printed instructions was useful.

options.label: D
options.text: The face-to-face training and the printed instructions were equally useful.

explanation.summary_zh: 現場示範讓大家順利完成，工作卡卻造成困惑，因此選 A。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前段說四位新志工第一次就正確裝好一袋，顯示現場示範有效；空格後則說書面工作卡的步驟順序錯誤，造成困惑。A 比較兩種指導方式，能同時連接前段的成功經驗與後文的具體缺點。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: A 說現場訓練較有幫助，符合示範後一次成功、工作卡卻造成困惑的對比。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: B 說現場訓練較沒幫助，將前後兩種指導方式的效果顛倒。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: C 說兩種指導都沒有幫助，與四人看完示範便首次成功的敘述不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: D 說兩種指導一樣有幫助，未能符合文章呈現的示範有效、工作卡造成困惑的差異。

evidence.quote: An instructor showed {{q1}} how to check package dates, and all four packed a bag correctly on the first attempt.
The task cards, which we used after the instructor left, caused confusion because two packing steps appeared in the wrong order.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 句子填空需同時連接前後證據，檢查比較的方向是否一致。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

explanation.summary_zh: inquiry 回指協調員詢問需要對調的步驟編號。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 協調員先致謝並提出寄送替換卡，接著詢問哪兩個步驟編號需要交換。作者回覆編號是在回答這個問題，因此 inquiry（詢問）準確指向前一句的發問，而非協調員已作出保證或修正。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: assurance 指保證或讓人放心的話；此處協調員是在詢問步驟編號，並未作出一項保證讓作者回應。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: correction 指修正；此時協調員仍在詢問要改哪兩個步驟，實際修正版是在作者回覆後才寄出。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: recommendation 指建議；協調員問的是哪些編號應交換，並未提出自己的更改建議。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: inquiry 指詢問，回指 she asked which two step numbers needed exchanging，作者因此回覆所問的編號。

evidence.quote: Before preparing it, she asked which two step numbers needed exchanging. I sent the numbers in response to her {{q3}}.
Within an hour of my reply, she sent a corrected card incorporating every change I had suggested.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 辨認回指事件的名詞時，須區分發問、保證、建議與實際修正。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 修正版納入所有建議的更動，表示建議已被採納。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前一句明確說修正版工作卡 incorporating every change I had suggested，也就是納入作者提出的每一項更動。這個實際結果支持 adopted（被採納），而空格所在句單獨並沒有足夠資訊判定建議受到何種處理。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: rejected 表示被拒絕；修正版已納入所有建議更動，與拒絕的結果相反。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: overlooked 表示被忽略；每一項建議都出現在修正版中，顯示協調員有處理這些建議。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: adopted 表示被採納，符合所有建議更動都已納入修正版的結果。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: misunderstood 表示被誤解；文中呈現的是作者所建議的每項更動都被照實納入，沒有誤解造成的偏差。

evidence.quote: Within an hour of my reply, she sent a corrected card incorporating every change I had suggested. My suggestions had clearly been {{q4}}.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷建議受到何種處理，可由前文描述的具體結果推回適合的動詞。

content.title: The Copper Clock Advertisement
content.scenario_summary: A touring theater company accepts an arts center's invitation. The venue's glass-fronted costume studio allows ticket holders an unexpected pre-show visit before the makers leave for the night, including advice for people making their own costumes.

documents.title: The Copper Clock: More Than a Night at the Theater

blocks.text: The Copper Clock: More Than a Night at the Theater
The Vellum Arts Center invited our company to bring The Copper Clock to its main hall. We decided to {{q1}} the invitation. Performances at the center begin on December 3.

The move brings an unexpected extra. The center's costume makers work in a glass-fronted lobby studio, then leave for the night as each evening performance begins. {{q2}} During this half hour, you can watch them transform everyday clothing into stage costumes.

The makers, {{q3}} also coach our cast on quick costume changes, will answer your questions. Are you hoping to make costumes yourself without buying new fabric? Ask how you can {{q4}} the garments already in your wardrobe.
Studio viewing is included with your theater ticket. Book your seat at vellumarts.example.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 劇團收到藝術中心的邀請，且將在該處演出，因此是 accept the invitation。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 四個動詞都能與 invitation 搭配，不能只靠搭配形式判斷。前句指出藝術中心是邀請方、劇團是受邀方；後句又宣布在該中心演出的開始日期。這兩項資訊共同確定劇團的行動是接受邀請。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: withdraw the invitation 是撤回邀請；本段的邀請由藝術中心發出，劇團是接收者，且已安排在該處演出。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: decline the invitation 是婉拒邀請，但後句宣布劇團將在該中心演出，與拒絕這項邀請不符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: extend the invitation 在此搭配中表示發出邀請；前句已交代藝術中心邀請劇團，並非劇團發出這項邀請。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: accept the invitation 是接受邀請，符合劇團受邀後將在藝術中心演出的安排。

evidence.quote: The Vellum Arts Center invited our company to bring The Copper Clock to its main hall.
We decided to {{q1}} the invitation.
Performances at the center begin on December 3.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 多個動詞都能搭配同一名詞時，要用前後文確認誰發起、誰回應，以及實際結果。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

options.label: A
options.text: We have added a thirty-minute studio visit after the evening show.

options.label: B
options.text: We have added a thirty-minute studio visit during the show's interval.

options.label: C
options.text: We have added a thirty-minute studio visit before the evening show.

options.label: D
options.text: We have added a thirty-minute studio visit while the show is running.

explanation.summary_zh: 製作人員在開演時就下班離開，因此現場觀看製作的半小時參觀須安排在開演前。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句說服裝製作人員在晚場開始時就離開，當晚不再工作；後句說觀眾能在 this half hour 親眼看他們製作服裝。空格既要引入這個半小時，也必須安排在人員仍在工作室的開演前。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 演出結束後，製作人員已在開演時下班離開，不能符合後句觀看他們現場製作的內容。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 中場休息已在演出開始之後；製作人員在開演時就離開，因此這時無法觀看他們工作。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 開演前的三十分鐘可讓觀眾看到仍在工作室的製作人員，也提供後句 this half hour 的明確所指。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 演出進行期間，製作人員已離開，不符合後句觀眾能看他們把日常衣物變成戲服的描述。

evidence.quote: The center's costume makers work in a glass-fronted lobby studio, then leave for the night as each evening performance begins.
During this half hour, you can watch them transform everyday clothing into stage costumes.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 句子補入題要把時間條件與後文的指示語一起核對，確認活動確實能在該時段發生。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

explanation.summary_zh: who 指代服裝製作人員，並在關係子句中擔任 coach 的主詞。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 主句是 The makers will answer your questions。兩個逗號之間補充說明這些製作人員也指導演員快速換裝。該關係子句已有動詞 coach，缺少的是表示人的主詞，因此選 who；our cast 則是 coach 的受詞。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: who 指代人的先行詞 the makers，並作 coach 的主詞，完整表達「這些人也指導演員」。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: whom 是受詞形式；此處 coach 前缺的是主詞，並非指導動作的受詞。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: whose 表示所屬關係，通常須與後面的名詞組合；此處接的是 also coach，不是所屬名詞片語。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: which 不適合在本句的補充關係子句中指代服裝製作人員這些人；此處應使用人的關係代名詞 who。

evidence.quote: The makers, {{q3}} also coach our cast on quick costume changes, will answer your questions.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 選關係代名詞時，先確認先行詞指人或物，再找出它在關係子句中擔任的角色。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 讀者想不買新布料、自己做戲服，因此應學習 adapt（改造）現有衣物。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 四個動詞都可以搭配衣物，但前一句明確設定讀者的目標：不用購買新布料，自己製作戲服。為了達成這個目標，讀者應向製作人員請教如何改造衣櫥裡已有的衣物，也呼應前段把日常衣物變成舞台戲服的示範。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: catalog 是編目或登錄；雖然衣物可以編目，但這不是把現有衣物製成戲服的改造方法。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: adapt 是為新用途調整或改造，符合不用買新布料、把已有衣物改成戲服的目標。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: donate 是捐贈；前句的目標是讀者自己做戲服，不是把現有衣物捐出去。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: store 是收存；把衣物收好並不能回應前句自己製作戲服所需的方法。

evidence.quote: Are you hoping to make costumes yourself without buying new fabric?
Ask how you can {{q4}} the garments already in your wardrobe.
During this half hour, you can watch them transform everyday clothing into stage costumes.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 多個動詞都能接同一受詞時，要用人物已說明的目標判斷哪個動作能達成目的。

content.title: Preparing the Hale Dispatch
content.scenario_summary: A warehouse coordinator asks a colleague to consolidate six orders to meet the receiving crew's single-visit goal and resend two missing driver documents as one PDF, while the final pallet is still being wrapped.

documents.title: Missing File for the Hale Dispatch

blocks.text: To: Jonas Vale
From: Rina Chen
Subject: Hale dispatch attachment
Hale's receiving crew wants to unload all six orders during one visit; it cannot staff separate deliveries this week. Please {{q1}} the dispatches.
Your last email arrived without the promised attachment. {{q2}} The driver needs both documents, and the dispatch portal accepts only one file per trip.
Uploading the file today will release the trip for loading. With tomorrow's collection still booked for 8:00 a.m., this will keep the dispatch {{q3}}.

The team {{q4}} the final pallet as I write. The wrapping is not finished yet, but it should be done in ten minutes. Please send the missing file by noon so I can upload it before leaving for an afternoon site visit.

Thanks,
Rina

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 收貨方希望一次卸完六筆訂單，因此需合併出貨。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前一句交代收貨團隊希望六筆訂單在同一次送達時卸貨，無法人手應付多次送貨。consolidate 表示把分開的出貨合併，能達成這個目標。後文仍安排今天放行裝車、明早八點收運，因此取消或延後出貨不符合整封信的安排；錯開出貨時程也無法滿足一次收貨的目的。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: cancel 表示取消；信中仍要求上傳檔案以放行裝車，並維持明早八點的收運預約，與取消這批出貨不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: defer 表示延後；信中要求今天完成裝車放行，並保留明早的收運時間，並不是要求把既定出貨往後延。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: stagger 表示錯開時間、分批安排，與收貨方希望只處理一次送達的目的相反。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: consolidate 表示合併，可讓原本的多筆出貨整合為一次送達，符合收貨方的目標。

evidence.quote: Hale's receiving crew wants to unload all six orders during one visit; it cannot staff separate deliveries this week. Please {{q1}} the dispatches.
Uploading the file today will release the trip for loading. With tomorrow's collection still booked for 8:00 a.m., this will keep the dispatch {{q3}}.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 情境字彙題應先找出當事人的目標，再選能表達所需行動的動詞。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

options.label: A
options.text: Could you resend the route map and leave out the unloading plan?

options.label: B
options.text: Could you resend the route map and unloading plan in one PDF?

options.label: C
options.text: Could you resend the unloading plan and leave out the route map?

options.label: D
options.text: Could you resend the route map and unloading plan in two PDFs?

explanation.summary_zh: 兩份文件都需要，且每趟只能上傳一個檔案，因此須合成一份 PDF。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格前說原本承諾的附件沒有收到；空格後的 both documents 需要回指兩份文件，同時系統又限制每趟只能有一個檔案。B 同時引入路線圖與卸貨計畫，並要求放在一份 PDF 裡，能滿足兩個銜接條件。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: A 要求省略卸貨計畫，與後句司機需要兩份文件不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: B 要求將路線圖與卸貨計畫放進一份 PDF，既提供兩份文件，也符合一個檔案的限制。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: C 要求省略路線圖，無法提供後句所說的兩份必要文件。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: D 雖然包括兩份文件，卻要求兩份 PDF，與系統每趟只接受一個檔案的限制不符。

evidence.quote: Your last email arrived without the promised attachment. {{q2}} The driver needs both documents, and the dispatch portal accepts only one file per trip.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 遇到 both 等回指詞，須確認前文引入的對象數量，並一併檢查後續條件。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 今天完成上傳即可開放裝車，讓出貨依原訂時間進行。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句說今天上傳就能讓這趟貨車開始裝貨，後句也指出明早八點的取貨預約維持不變。這項行動是在維持原定出貨進度，因此 keep the dispatch on schedule 表示讓出貨按時進行。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: on schedule 表示按預定時間進行，符合今天開放裝貨、維持明早取貨安排的結果。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: on hold 表示暫停；上傳檔案會開放裝貨，並非繼續讓出貨停擺。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: under review 表示正在審查；文中說上傳後會開放裝貨，沒有說出貨將轉入審查狀態。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: at risk 表示處於風險中；此處上傳是為了維持既定出貨安排，並未造成新的風險。

evidence.quote: Uploading the file today will release the trip for loading. With tomorrow's collection still booked for 8:00 a.m., this will keep the dispatch {{q3}}.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 選搭配片語時，除確認文法，也要核對它是否表達前文行動的結果。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 寄信時包膜作業仍未完成，因此使用現在進行式。
explanation.reasoning_zh: as I write 將動作定位在作者正在寫信的當下，下一句又明說包膜尚未完成，預計十分鐘後才完成。is wrapping 表達這項正在進行的作業；其他選項在此會把包膜表為已完成，或改放到未來的完成時間點。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: had wrapped 表示在某個過去參照點之前已完成包膜，與寄信當下仍在進行的敘述不符。

option_analysis.label: B

content.title: A Better-Packed Replacement
content.scenario_summary: A reviewer collects a replacement water pitcher from a courier depot before a staff dinner because scheduled office delivery would be too late, and praises the replacement's protective tray while questioning the original loose packaging.

blocks.text: Good Pitchers, Better Replacement Packaging
Review by Dani Shaw

I ordered six Elmwick water pitchers for our staff dinner. Five arrived safely, but the sixth had a cracked handle. After I sent a photo, the seller offered an identical replacement, with delivery to our office scheduled for June 9. Instead, I collected it from the courier's depot on June 7.

The dinner was on June 8. I took the new pitcher home and left it boxed until I packed everything for the event. It came in a molded cardboard tray that held the handle away from the box walls, unlike the original loose packing. All six pitchers looked good on the tables and poured without dripping. I would order again, but I would ask which packaging will be used.

content.title: First Landscaping Project Advertisement
content.scenario_summary: A landscape studio advertises planning support to workplace employees newly responsible for an outdoor-space redesign. The service progresses from a site visit to a subsequently prepared sketch and then, after the customer's review, an itemized quotation.

documents.title: Your First Landscaping Brief? Start Here.

blocks.text: Your First Landscaping Brief? Start Here.

Has your employer put you in charge of redesigning the outdoor space at your workplace? Larchfield Landscape Studio's Start With a Sketch service helps you turn colleagues' requests into a clear plan, even if you have never managed a landscape project.

A designer will visit your site to discuss how staff use the grounds and which changes matter most. We will prepare and e-mail your preliminary sketch after that visit. An itemized quotation is produced only after your team has reviewed the sketch and returned its comments.

You can revise the sketch before committing to any planting or construction. The service costs $85, credited toward a full design package if you continue with us. Reserve an initial visit at larchfield.example/brief.

questions.prompt: Who is the advertisement primarily intended for?

explanation.reasoning_zh: 廣告的受眾線索是 employer、in charge of redesigning 與 outdoor space at your workplace。服務協助員工把同事的需求整理成設計計畫，也照顧沒有景觀專案經驗的人。這明確指向負責戶外改造專案的員工，而不是單純採購家具、安排活動或排定日常維護。

content.title: Westbridge Balance-Class Article
content.scenario_summary: A community article corrects its earlier claim that rising enrollment caused a fitness center to move beginner balance classes. The move addresses noise complaints; the larger studio accompanies a smaller class limit, allowing personal feedback that leads a member to book another course.

blocks.text: A Quieter Start at Westbridge

This month's changes at Westbridge Fitness Center have generated several questions from readers. [[1]] The center has moved its beginner balance classes to a different studio. Last week's column attributed the move to rising enrollment. Manager Anika Bose has since clarified that complaints about music from the weight room drowning out instructions prompted the change.

The new studio is farther from the weight room and offers nearly twice the floor space of the old studio. [[2]] Instructor Jonah Reed says that reduction gives him time to check each person's movements, rather than simply demonstrate exercises to the whole group.

Member Elise Tan recalls leaving the old classes unsure whether she was doing the exercises correctly. During her first class in the new studio, Reed noticed that her feet were too close together and helped her adjust. Tan has since booked the next six-week course. [[3]]
The class timetable and membership fees are unchanged. The center has asked the community column to publish the explanation alongside its next class listing. [[4]]

questions.prompt: What prompted the center to move its beginner balance classes?

options.label: A
options.text: A need to accommodate an increase in enrollment

options.label: B
options.text: A decision to provide longer exercise sessions

options.label: C
options.text: Complaints that the instructor's directions were difficult to hear

options.label: D
options.text: A desire to give participants more individual feedback

explanation.summary_zh: 經理更正說，重訓室音樂蓋過指示所引起的抱怨，才是搬動教室的原因。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 本文先提到先前專欄把搬遷歸因於報名人數增加，隨後以 has since clarified 更正。經理明說，重訓室的音樂使學員聽不清指示，相關抱怨促成了搬遷。個別指導增加是後文介紹小班人數時的效果，不能拿來取代這項明示的搬遷起因。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 報名增加是上週專欄原先給出的說法；本文已用經理的澄清將它更正為噪音抱怨。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 本文沒有說要延長每堂課，結尾反而指出課表未變；明示的搬遷原因是音樂干擾口頭指示。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 符合 music ... drowning out instructions，表示重訓室音樂蓋過指示，導致學員抱怨而促成搬遷。

option_analysis.label: D

content.title: Bookshop Edition-Comparison Notice
content.scenario_summary: An independent bookshop explains its edition-comparison service through a customer's experience choosing a readable gift for her father. Full-size printed samples let her compare print with his current book; she orders an edition and asks for service cards to share with her walking group.

documents.title: A Clearer Way to Choose a Gift Book

blocks.text: A Clearer Way to Choose a Gift Book
Buying a book for someone whose reading needs differ from yours? Ask us at Alder Page Books for help comparing editions. [[1]]
Customer Nia Cole recently visited us to choose a local-history book for her father. Her father struggles with small print, and the online previews kept resizing to fit her phone screen. [[2]]

Nia placed these sheets beside her father's current book, which she had brought along to check the print size. She selected the edition with the closest match and placed an order. She told us, 'On my phone, the two editions had looked the same.' Before leaving, she asked for extra cards describing our service to give to her walking group. [[3]]

When publishers supply sample pages, we can print them for comparison. We can also check which editions are available and order the one you choose. The comparison is free, and there is no obligation to buy. Speak to a bookseller at the counter. [[4]]

questions.prompt: Where would this sentence fit most naturally in the passage? "We then printed one full-size sample page from each edition and set the two sheets on the counter."

content.title: Continuing the Harbor-Tour Referral Trial
content.scenario_summary: A harbor-tour operator writes to participating hotel guest-services managers after they have agreed to extend a referral trial. It explains replacement cards and reporting arrangements; frequent timetable changes and guests keeping cards motivate a switch from printed departures to an online schedule link.

blocks.text: July 25
To: Guest-services managers at participating hotels
Dear Trial Partners,

Thank you for the notes from the first three weeks of our harbor-tour referral trial. At last week's joint meeting, all six hotels agreed to extend the test. The trial will therefore run until August 31. The referral fee remains unchanged, and no additional agreement is required.

Harbor maintenance has led us to revise departure times at short notice, and the work will continue throughout August. Your reception teams also report that many guests take a card several days before deciding whether to book.

For the additional month, the new cards will carry a QR code in place of printed departure times. It opens the same online timetable used by our ticket office. Each hotel's referral code will remain on the cards, so bookings can still be correctly credited.
We will deliver new cards to your desks on August 1. Please stop handing out the old version once the replacements arrive; you may recycle unused copies. Existing bookings are not affected.

Continue sending weekly booking totals through the usual form. These reports will give us a clearer picture of the program's performance. We will send you our findings in September before deciding whether to make the system permanent.

Yours sincerely,
Ada Bennett
Partnerships Coordinator
Alder Bay Harbor Tours

documents.title: Employee Benefits Selection: Revised Support Schedule

blocks.text: Employee Benefits Selection: Revised Support Schedule
Selection period: June 2–18. Coverage begins July 1.

Following the benefits-portal outage on June 12–13, the enrollment deadline has moved from June 14 to 5:00 P.M. on June 18. Use the sessions below to compare plans, ask questions, and complete your selections. All times are local.

content.title: Requesting a Personalized Reading Pack
content.scenario_summary: Public-library instructions explain how members state reading preferences, allow time for staff selection, name someone to collect a pack charged as loans to their own account, and opt into an unfamiliar genre.

documents.title: Westmere Public Library — Personalized Reading Packs

blocks.text: Westmere Public Library
Personalized Reading Packs: Member Instructions

Request a pack of two books chosen from the stock at your pickup branch. On the request form, tell us whether you enjoy light fiction or more challenging books. List two favorite authors and any subjects you prefer to avoid. You can change these preferences before each new request.

Choose a collection date at least three working days after submitting the form. Staff select packs between their regular desk shifts, so this interval gives them time to review your preferences and check the shelves. When your pack is ready, we will email you and keep it behind the desk for five working days.

Under "Pickup Name," you may enter a name other than your own. The person named must show their own photo identification at collection. Books from the pack will be borrowed on your library account, regardless of who shows the identification. The normal loan period applies.

If you want to branch out, tick "Surprise me." Staff will include one book from a genre outside your listed interests. Otherwise, both books will reflect your stated preferences. You can leave a short comment about your selection on the next request form.

questions.prompt: The word "light" in the instructions is closest in meaning to

explanation.summary_zh: light 在此形容小說讀來輕鬆、不太費心力。
explanation.reasoning_zh: light 修飾 fiction，並與 more challenging books 對照，因此是在區分閱讀內容需要投入的心力。這裡不是談書本重量、顏色或數量，而是指較不費心力的小說。

option_analysis.reason_zh: 此處比較的是小說的閱讀難度，不是紙本書的實際重量。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Not intellectually demanding 表示不太需要費心思，符合與 more challenging books 的對比。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: fiction 指內容類型，段落沒有比較封面或紙張的顏色深淺。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 每包固定兩本書，light 在此沒有表達書籍數量少的意思。

evidence.quote: On the request form, tell us whether you enjoy light fiction or more challenging books.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 多義形容詞可由所修飾的名詞與對照語判斷這次採用哪一個意思。

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.label: C

explanation.reasoning_zh: 指引直接說館員在 regular desk shifts 之間選書，三個工作天讓他們能檢視偏好並查看書架。A 改述這個準備期的原因；五個工作天則是選書包完成後的領取保留期，不能拿來解釋前面的準備時間。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 五個工作天是收到完成通知後的保留時間，屬於後續領取安排，並非要求提前三天的原因。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 選書包使用 pickup branch 的現有館藏，文中沒有先從其他分館運書的流程。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 指引允許每次提出新申請前更新偏好，沒有說只能在三天準備期間更改。

Staff select packs between their regular desk shifts, so this interval gives them time to review your preferences and check the shelves. option_analysis.label: A

option_analysis.label: B

content.title: A Workshop Booklet Order
content.scenario_summary: A print-shop advertisement promises color covers with monochrome inside pages and requires a fault photo plus affected-copy total for reprints. After an unexpected van problem delays the original delivery, a housing organization workshop coordinator reports an inspected carton of entirely monochrome booklets and attaches a photo, but other cartons remain sealed. Comparing the sources establishes the unfulfilled count requirement and the specific cover-color shortfall. Separately, participant kits had been sealed and collected before the booklet delivery arrived, so those booklets are absent from the kits.

blocks.text: Northbridge Print
Workshop booklets, ready to hand out

Our Workshop Booklet package combines full-color covers with black-and-white inside pages. We staple each copy along the spine and can produce booklets of up to forty pages. The package includes one delivery to a local office. Small orders receive the same attention as large ones.
Our reprint promise

If there is a printing fault, email us a photograph that shows the problem and state the total number of affected copies. Both are needed before Evan Pace, our reprint coordinator, can clear a replacement job for production. We collect the faulty copies when their replacements are delivered, so keep the cartons until then.
For a quote, send your page count and desired quantity to orders@northbridgeprint.example.
To: Evan Pace <evan.pace@northbridgeprint.example>
From: Nina Flores <nina.flores@bellfordhousing.example>
Date: November 12
Subject: Booklets delivered yesterday
Dear Mr. Pace,

Your courier delivered our 120 booklets at 3:00 p.m. yesterday after a van problem delayed the scheduled morning delivery. We ordered your Workshop Booklet package for Bellford Housing's November 14 training day. I coordinate our staff workshops.
The booklets in the carton I opened are printed entirely in black and white. I have attached a photograph of an opened copy. The other cartons remain sealed in our office stockroom.
The venue collected the participant kits from our office at noon yesterday. Each kit had been sealed the evening before, and the venue will hand them out unopened at registration.
Please contact me by email about the replacement printing. Our team moves to the venue tomorrow morning, though the stockroom will remain accessible to your driver through our office receptionist.

Nina Flores
Bellford Housing

questions.prompt: What is Nina Flores responsible for at Bellford Housing?

options.label: B
options.text: Coordinating the production of replacement booklets

options.label: D
options.text: Preparing artwork for the print shop

explanation.summary_zh: C 正確；Flores 明確表示自己負責統籌員工工作坊。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 電子郵件第一段的 I coordinate our staff workshops 直接說明 Flores 的工作角色。選項 C 將 coordinate 改述為 Organizing，並以 training workshops 表達這次員工培訓活動。

content.title: Shared Airport Shuttle Allocation
content.scenario_summary: Three hotels pool a spare airport minibus. An article explains the scheme's division of duties and a manager's response to a successful trial. documents.title: Hotels Put Spare Shuttle Capacity to Work

blocks.text: Hotels Put Spare Shuttle Capacity to Work
Airport Business Review | November 12

Three independent hotels near Lydon Airport have begun sharing a spare minibus instead of keeping a backup at each property. The pool covers short periods of uneven demand while the hotels continue their regular shuttle services.

A duty planner compares passenger forecasts and allocates the spare vehicle among the hotels. Mechanical readiness remains with the fleet coordinator; driver assignments belong to the dispatch supervisor. Each hotel liaison supplies the guest counts for that property.

Bayfield Hotel manager Lena Quinn had expected sharing with other properties to slow her team's response. During the pilot, a delayed flight left two groups needing pickup at once; a pooled vehicle reached the terminal before her regular shuttle had finished its first trip. Quinn has now offered a second vehicle for the pool on busy days. The local hotels' association will review the trial in December before inviting more properties to join.
From: Theo Marin
To: Priya Nair
Date: November 17, 2:15 P.M.
Subject: Spare van for the 6:10 P.M. airport arrival

Priya, your updated passenger counts show that Bayfield's arrival group now exceeds its own shuttle capacity. I have compared all three hotels' forecasts and allocated the pool's spare van to Bayfield for 6:10 P.M. The other hotels can cover their passengers with their regular vehicles; their return-trip times remain unchanged.

Please check the flight number on the movement sheet by 5:00 P.M. I will sign the checked sheet and send a copy at 5:30 P.M. to whoever is carrying the duty mobile. That person will choose a driver and confirm the reassignment with the receiving hotel.

Please enter the final arrangement in the shared log so desk staff and drivers stay on the same page. The van will return to the common pool after this trip; it is not being permanently transferred to Bayfield.
Theo
Shared Shuttle: Evening Handover
For front-desk staff at participating hotels | November 17
Send tomorrow's airport passenger totals to Priya Nair before 4:00 P.M. Include separate counts for inbound and outbound journeys, together with the relevant flight times.
Jonas Bell carries the duty mobile until 4:00 P.M., then transfers it to Mina Cho until midnight. Priya Nair monitors the reservations inbox throughout the evening.

If a flight time changes after your initial report, amend the existing entry on the shared form instead of creating a duplicate. Overnight requests will be reviewed at 6:00 A.M. Keep the automated acknowledgment until morning.
