explanation.reasoning_zh: Quinn 原先擔心共用安排會拖慢反應，但試行時，另一部共用車在自家接駁車尚未完成首趟前就抵達機場，處理同時出現的兩批旅客。她隨後提出在忙碌日再提供一部車。具體成果與增加投入的回應，支持她對制度處理突發需求的信心提高。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 反應變慢是她試行前的擔心；後續及時接送的經驗，加上她已提出在忙碌日提供第二部車，並不支持把先前的擔心當成她目前的結論。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中共用車正好協助處理延誤航班造成的突發需求，沒有她主張只能用於預定接送的限制。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她看到共用車及時補足運能，之後願意提供第二部車，合理顯示她更信任方案應付需求變動的能力。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文章描述三間飯店共用車輛，她並未質疑多飯店運作；增加自身投入的回應也不支持這種懷疑。

evidence.quote: Bayfield Hotel manager Lena Quinn had expected sharing with other properties to slow her team's response.
During the pilot, a delayed flight left two groups needing pickup at once; a pooled vehicle reached the terminal before her regular shuttle had finished its first trip.
Quinn has now offered a second vehicle for the pool on busy days.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 態度推論要留意前後轉變，並把實際成效與人物後續願意投入的資源一起判讀。

questions.prompt: Who is expected to select a driver after Theo sends the checked movement sheet at 5:30 P.M. on November 17?

explanation.summary_zh: 郵件將選駕駛的責任交給持值班手機者，而五點半該手機已由 Mina Cho 接手。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 郵件沒有直接寫出接手者姓名，而是說 Theo 於五點半把已核對簽署的調度單交給持值班手機的人，由該人選派駕駛。通知再提供當日手機交接：Jonas 四點前持有，四點後交給 Mina 直到午夜。因此五點半接到這項責任的是 Mina。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: Mina 在下午四點至午夜持有值班手機，符合郵件指定五點半接收調度單並選派駕駛的接手者。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Jonas 雖然也持過同一支手機，但只到下午四點；五點半已交班給 Mina。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Priya 收到 Theo 的郵件並負責核對航班號碼；通知說她監看訂位信箱，並非五點半的值班手機持有人。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Theo 負責簽署並轉交調度單；郵件明確把接下來選派駕駛與向接收飯店確認的工作交給手機持有人。

evidence.quote: I will sign the checked sheet and send a copy at 5:30 P.M. to whoever is carrying the duty mobile. That person will choose a driver and confirm the reassignment with the receiving hotel.
Jonas Bell carries the duty mobile until 4:00 P.M., then transfers it to Mina Cho until midnight.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 跨文件交接題先追蹤工作被交給哪個職務或聯絡管道，再用當日值班資訊定位到人，並核對交班時間。

questions.prompt: In the email, the phrase "on the same page" is closest in meaning to

explanation.summary_zh: on the same page 在此指大家對最終安排有一致理解，而非真的讀同一頁。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Theo 要求把最終安排記入共用紀錄，目的是讓櫃檯與駕駛對調度安排掌握相同資訊。on the same page 是表示理解一致的慣用語；它不表示人員必須同時抵達、在同地工作或一起閱讀某份文件。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 同時抵達涉及行程時間，但把安排登錄共用紀錄的目的，是資訊一致，不是讓所有人同時到達。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 櫃檯與駕駛可在不同地點工作；這個片語談的是共同理解，而不是共用工作場所。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 閱讀同一份文件是字面的聯想；即使大家會參考共用紀錄，片語本身表達的仍是對事情理解一致。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: sharing the same understanding 保留慣用語的意思，符合登錄最終調度安排以避免認知不一致的語境。

evidence.quote: Please enter the final arrangement in the shared log so desk staff and drivers stay on the same page.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 片語題要把整個片語放回溝通目的中理解，避免只抓 page 等單字作字面翻譯。

questions.prompt: Which role described in the article is Theo performing in his email?

explanation.summary_zh: 文章把比較需求並分配共用車的工作交給 duty planner；Theo 在郵件中正執行這項工作。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 文章定義本方案的分工：duty planner 比較人數預測、決定共用備用車分給哪間飯店。Theo 的郵件則顯示他比較三間飯店的預測後，把共用車分配給 Bayfield。郵件未列職稱，必須將他的具體行動與文章的職責定義對照。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 依文章，fleet coordinator 負責車況與機械妥善性；Theo 這封郵件的核心行動是比較旅客需求並分配車輛。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: hotel liaison 負責提供各飯店旅客人數；Theo 使用已更新的人數進行跨飯店比較與車輛分配，不只是回報單一飯店資料。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Theo 比較三間飯店的預測後分配共用備用車，正好對應文章對 duty planner 的職責定義。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文章把選派駕駛交給 dispatch supervisor；郵件中 Theo 將該步驟交給持值班手機者，自己的行動是先決定車輛用途。

evidence.quote: A duty planner compares passenger forecasts and allocates the spare vehicle among the hotels.
I have compared all three hotels' forecasts and allocated the pool's spare van to Bayfield for 6:10 P.M.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 跨文件職責題要以一份文件的具體行動對照另一份文件的方案分工，不能只憑一般職稱印象。

content.title: A Limited-Capacity Collection Plan
content.scenario_summary: An original confirmation reserves an eight-pallet pickup at Bay 2. A later warehouse email reports completed rewrapping and inspection and limits the replacement truck to four pallets per visit. BASES is prioritized because assembly can begin independently before upright panels are attached. A still later final dispatch sheet places both collection visits at Bay 3. One join compares the original and final bay assignments; another orders the email-reported preparation stages before the separate dispatch-sheet issuance timestamp.

blocks.text: Harborline Freight: Collection Booking Confirmed

Issued: November 14
Booking: HF6824
Customer: Rowan Fixtures
We have reserved a full-size vehicle to collect eight pallets of display equipment from Rowan's South Warehouse on November 18. The load will travel to Bellgrove Design Center.

Loading appointment: 11:30 a.m.
Assigned loading location: Bay 2

Allow twenty minutes for loading. The driver must present the booking reference at reception before entering the loading yard. Do not bring the vehicle to the bay until a warehouse marshal calls it forward.

Changes to the load size or destination should reach dispatch@harborlinefreight.example before 5:00 p.m. on November 17. Pallets must remain on the warehouse floor until a staff member is ready to load them.
To: Dispatch Team <dispatch@harborlinefreight.example>
From: Ilona Shaw <ilona.shaw@rowanfixtures.example>
Date: November 17, 11:15 a.m.
Subject: HF6824 — tomorrow's load
The eight pallets are ready. Rewrapping finished at 9:00 this morning. The safety inspection began at 10:00 and ended at 10:30. The booking reference and destination are unchanged.
Your dispatcher has confirmed that only a compact truck is available for our booking tomorrow. Its maximum capacity is four pallets, so it will need to return for the remainder.

The first four should be the pallets marked BASES, which contain the base frames and all their brackets. The installation crew at the design center is booked for 11:00 a.m. tomorrow. It can assemble these frames independently; the upright panels are attached at a later stage.
Please collect the pallets marked PANELS on the second visit. Let the driver know which group comes first. Our warehouse crew will follow the final dispatch sheet for bay assignments.

Ilona Shaw
Shipping Coordinator, Rowan Fixtures
South Warehouse: Final Dispatch Sheet

Dispatch date: November 18
Issued: November 17, 1:00 p.m.
Scheduled loading appointments

This sheet supersedes bay assignments on booking confirmations. Drivers who arrive early must use the marked holding area until a marshal calls them forward. Staff move pallets into the loading bay after the vehicle is positioned. Keep the access lane clear.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the booking confirmation?

options.label: A
options.text: To explain how drivers should check into the loading yard

options.label: B
options.text: To describe how loading equipment is chosen for shipments

options.label: C
options.text: To confirm collection arrangements for a particular shipment

options.label: D
options.text: To advertise storage space for incoming warehouse deliveries

explanation.summary_zh: C 正確；文件主要確認特定貨物的取件安排，報到規定只是其中的附帶指引。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 確認單載明預留車輛、八個棧板、取件日期、目的地、裝貨時段及貨灣，核心功能是確認這筆貨物的取件安排。文件確實也告知司機如何報到，但這只是執行已確認安排時的作業指示。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: A 是文件中真實存在的附帶用途，reception 核對預約編號即屬報到指引；但它未涵蓋車輛、貨量、日期與裝貨預約等主要內容。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: B 不符；文件說已預留車輛，沒有說明如何挑選裝貨設備或比較設備規格。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: C 涵蓋文件最主要的確認功能，包括已預留的車輛與特定貨物的取件時間、地點及目的地。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: D 不符；此文件是已有預約的取件確認，不是在推銷可供新進貨物使用的倉儲空間。

evidence.quote: We have reserved a full-size vehicle to collect eight pallets of display equipment from Rowan's South Warehouse on November 18. The load will travel to Bellgrove Design Center.

Loading appointment: 11:30 a.m.
Assigned loading location: Bay 2
The driver must present the booking reference at reception before entering the loading yard.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 整體功能題要選能統整文件主要資訊的目的，不要只選真實但次要的作業提醒。

questions.prompt: Why does Ms. Shaw want the BASES pallets collected first?

options.label: A
options.text: To allow assembly work to start without the upright panels

options.label: B
options.text: To make room for a delivery of new display stock

options.label: C
options.text: To reduce the number of pallets requiring safety inspection

options.label: D
options.text: To reserve the mounting brackets for the second visit

explanation.summary_zh: A 正確；底座可獨立組裝，先送底座能讓安裝人員不必等直立面板到齊才開始。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 信中先說 BASES 組含底座框架及支架，再說安裝人員已約好到場，而且底座可以獨立組裝、面板稍後才裝。把這些線索結合，可推知先取底座是為了讓安裝工作能在面板抵達前開始。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: A 結合先送貨物的內容與可獨立進行的組裝階段，合理說明為何先送 BASES 而不是 PANELS。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: B 沒有支持；信中提到的是車輛載量受限，沒有說另有新展示品要送進倉庫，因此不能推成清空收貨空間。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: C 與信中已完成安全檢查的資訊不符；優先取哪組貨物不會減少這批已檢查棧板的數量。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: D 與 BASES 組已包含全部底座支架的資訊衝突；先送 BASES 會把支架一併送出，而不是留給第二趟。

evidence.quote: The first four should be the pallets marked BASES, which contain the base frames and all their brackets. The installation crew at the design center is booked for 11:00 a.m. tomorrow. It can assemble these frames independently; the upright panels are attached at a later stage.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 動機推論可把「先提供什麼」與「對方能先進行哪個步驟」連起來，避免加入未述的費用或作業慣例。

questions.prompt: How did the loading location for booking HF6824 change?

explanation.summary_zh: D 正確；原確認單指定第 2 貨灣，後出的最終表改列第 3 貨灣。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 11 月 14 日的確認單把 HF6824 指派到 Bay 2。11 月 17 日發出的最終派車表中，這筆預約的兩次裝貨都在 Bay 3，且表上說明此表取代確認單的貨灣安排，因此變更是 2 到 3。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: A 的新貨灣 Bay 3 正確，但原確認單指定的是 Bay 2，不是 Bay 1。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: B 的原貨灣 Bay 2 正確，但最終表中的 HF6824 兩趟均在 Bay 3，Bay 4 是其他預約使用的貨灣。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: C 的兩端都不符；原確認單是 Bay 2，而最終表對這筆預約指定 Bay 3。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: D 正確連接原確認單的 Bay 2 與後出最終派車表的 Bay 3，方向與先後狀態一致。

evidence.quote: Assigned loading location: Bay 2
Bay 3
This sheet supersedes bay assignments on booking confirmations.
Issued: November 14
Issued: November 17, 1:00 p.m.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 變更題要分別找到舊、新文件的同一預約，再依較新且具取代效力的安排比較。

questions.prompt: In what order did the preparation and scheduling events occur?

options.label: A
options.text: Inspecting the pallets → issuing the dispatch sheet → rewrapping the pallets

options.label: B
options.text: Rewrapping the pallets → inspecting the pallets → issuing the dispatch sheet

options.label: C
options.text: Issuing the dispatch sheet → rewrapping the pallets → inspecting the pallets

options.label: D
options.text: Inspecting the pallets → rewrapping the pallets → issuing the dispatch sheet

explanation.summary_zh: B 正確；先完成重新包膜，再完成檢查，最後發出最終派車表。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 11 月 17 日的信指出，當天上午九點完成重新包膜，安全檢查於十點開始、十點半完成。另一份文件標示最終派車表於同日午後一點發出，因此順序為重新包膜、檢查、發表。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: A 把重新包膜放在最後，但信中明確指出九點包膜已完成，早於十點半檢查及午後一點發表。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: B 符合兩份文件的三個時間：上午九點完成包膜、十點半完成檢查、下午一點發出派車表。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: C 保留了包膜早於檢查的關係，但錯把派車表放在兩項準備工作之前；表的發出時間是當日下午一點。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: D 把檢查與重新包膜的先後顛倒；信中九點完成包膜，十點半才完成安全檢查。

evidence.quote: Date: November 17, 11:15 a.m.
Rewrapping finished at 9:00 this morning. The safety inspection began at 10:00 and ended at 10:30.
Issued: November 17, 1:00 p.m.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先用文件日期定位 this morning，再把另一文件的發出時間放入同一時間線。

questions.prompt: Where should drivers wait if they arrive before their loading appointments?

options.label: A
options.text: In the designated vehicle waiting area

options.label: B
options.text: In the access lane leading to the bays

options.label: C
options.text: In the office where booking references are checked

options.label: D
options.text: In an empty bay assigned to another vehicle

explanation.summary_zh: A 正確；提早抵達的司機須在標示的等候區等待通知。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 最終派車表註明，提早抵達的司機要使用 marked holding area，直到調度人員叫車前進。選項 A 以 designated vehicle waiting area 改述該指定等候區；不應把通道或暫時空著的貨灣當作停等處。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: A 以指定的車輛等候區改述 marked holding area，符合提早抵達時等待調度通知的規定。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: B 與 Keep the access lane clear 衝突；通往貨灣的通道必須保持暢通。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: C 所指辦公室不是派車表指定的車輛等候區，不能把文件核對地點當成提早到場的停等處。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: D 不符；司機需在等候區等調度人員叫車，不能因別的貨灣暫時空著就自行占用。

evidence.quote: Drivers who arrive early must use the marked holding area until a marshal calls them forward. Staff move pallets into the loading bay after the vehicle is positioned. Keep the access lane clear.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 細節題留意同義改述；holding area 是等待調度的指定區域，不是作業貨灣或通道。

content.title: A Recycling Trial and the Decision to Continue
content.scenario_summary: A recycling-service web page offers a two-collection office trial and next-day weight records. Neutral customer feedback records later report dates and a preference for affirmative monthly renewal. An internal email recommends continuing and confirms automatic renewal, creating separate claim-versus-experience and preference-versus-outcome comparisons.

blocks.text: ClearCycle Office Collection Trial

Try two weekly collections before deciding whether to book regular service. Offices in the Market Street area can join our trial on September 8 and 15. Enroll by September 3 using the form below. The trial covers both visits and does not require an ongoing subscription.
What to expect

On both dates, our crew will arrive between 10:00 a.m. and noon. We accept clean office paper and flattened cardboard. Place these materials just inside your building's rear service entrance, where the crew will collect them. No employee needs to meet the vehicle. Keep the doorway clear.
After each pickup, you will receive a digital weight record by noon the following day. The record shows the combined weight of the paper and cardboard, rather than separate totals for each material.
Trial Feedback Form
Submitted: September 18
Respondent: Nia Patel, Office Coordinator, Market Street Design
Collection notes

September 8: vehicle arrived at 10:40 a.m. September 15: vehicle arrived at 11:05 a.m. Both loads contained office paper and flattened cardboard. The crew took both materials from just inside our rear service entrance. No one from our office met the vehicle.
Weight-record emails received: September 10 at 9:00 a.m.; September 17 at 11:00 a.m.
Comments and preferences for regular service

Preparing the materials took little staff time. For regular service, my main preference is to approve each additional month myself. I would rather receive a request to continue than have to remember a cancellation deadline.
From: Evan Ross, Operations Manager
To: Nia Patel
Date: September 19
Subject: Continuing the recycling service

I recommend keeping ClearCycle after the trial. The directors agreed this morning, and I have accepted the regular-service confirmation. Our first regular collection is set for September 22. Please brief reception on September 21 so they know the arrangement is continuing.

The confirmation covers one month at a time. A further month is added automatically unless we cancel at least five working days before the current month ends. Invoices will be paid from the facilities budget.
You deserve credit for keeping everyone informed during the trial. Please retain the same preparation instructions and keep a short log of weekly volumes for our next review on October 20.

Thanks,
Evan

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of the web page?

options.label: A
options.text: To explain what information a collection record contains

options.label: B
options.text: To invite offices to test a recycling service

options.label: C
options.text: To summarize the findings from an office recycling trial

options.label: D
options.text: To announce a new renewal policy for existing customers

explanation.summary_zh: 網頁主要邀請辦公室試用回收收運服務。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 網頁一開始邀請辦公室先試用兩次收運，並提供參加日期與報名截止日；後面的收運方式及重量紀錄都是協助讀者了解試用內容。說明重量紀錄確實是其中一部分，但不足以代表整頁的主要功能。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 網頁確實說明紀錄包含合計重量，但這只是介紹試用服務時的附屬資訊，不是整頁主要目的。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 開頭 Try two weekly collections 與報名資訊共同表明網頁在邀請辦公室試用服務。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 這是試用服務的介紹與報名說明，尚未呈現任何辦公室的試用成效。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 網頁說試用不要求持續訂閱，並沒有公告既有客戶的續約政策變更。

evidence.quote: Try two weekly collections before deciding whether to book regular service. Offices in the Market Street area can join our trial on September 8 and 15. Enroll by September 3 using the form below. The trial covers both visits and does not require an ongoing subscription.
The record shows the combined weight of the paper and cardboard, rather than separate totals for each material.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷整體功能時，須區分邀請讀者採取的主要行動與提供該行動所需的附屬說明。

questions.prompt: Which aspect of the trial did NOT match the information on the web page?

options.label: A
options.text: The period in which the crew arrived

options.label: B
options.text: The range of materials that the crew accepted

options.label: C
options.text: The wait before the weight records arrived
